agent_discovery.description: Preview one new relative end-effector displacement from the current measured pose through the Integrated Controller. Repeated requests are cumulative: each request creates another displacement from the latest measured pose. Before using this Skill, inspect runtime and activate robot_arm.rebot_dm to HOT first, then robot_arm.primary.integrated to HOT. In the arm-base frame, UP is positive Y because gravity is negative Y. PREVIEW_READY is not a completed workflow: immediately call the returned required_next_tool with its arguments unchanged to present the separate physical-execution approval.
when_to_use: The operator requests a new relative Cartesian end-effector displacement.
The Basic and Integrated arm Providers can be activated in dependency order.
A fresh measured controlled-frame pose is available.
when_not_to_use: The request is safe-home, gravity float, emergency stop, or raw joint control.
The collision scene or required controller state is unavailable and the operator does not accept that limitation.
side_effects: May require approval-gated activation of the Basic and Integrated arm Providers.
Stages a nonphysical Integrated Controller target and preview.
Does not itself authorize or execute physical motion.

provider_activation_sequence.reason: Owns the hardware, joint feedback, gravity float, and fenced operational control.
Owns Cartesian IK preview and one-shot motion execution.
